programs.title: Kriol Kitchen
programs.sub_title: Denise Andrews Macale: Bush Turkey Stew & Chilli Fresh Water Mussels In White Wine
programs.desc: Denise Andrews Macale, with the help of Mitch and Ali, turns the humble bush turkey into a delicious stew using basic vegetables and Asian sauces to complement the gamey taste of this native bird.

programs.title: Marcus Wareing's Kitchen Garden Tales
programs.desc: There is an abundance of fruits falling from the trees in the orchard that often go to waste. Marcus decides to make them into his own cider and visits an expert to help him fulfill this idea.

programs.title: My Market Kitchen
programs.desc: Matt is in the Noosa Surf Club, cooking up a great way to start the day with his spinach and ricotta dumplings. Laura's in the Adelaide Central Market making sticky date pudding.

programs.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programs.desc: Lidia loves to talk about cravings. She makes American-style recipes but with an Italian twist - pan pizza and mozzarella cheeseburger. The culinary chat focuses on chicken cutlets today!

programs.title: Tom Kerridge's Pub Kitchen Secrets
programs.desc: Tom puts a spotlight on some fresh ingredients. Tom and his team debut a new sea bass dish and a delicious starter of courgettes and goat's cheese.

programs.title: The Food That Built Asia
programs.desc: One of Hong Kong's most popular dishes is a small bite made with shrimp and lots of love.
